name: Textarea
summary: A textarea is a multi-line text field. Use it for a value that runs longer than a line: a note, a reply, a bio. It is accessible before you touch it, so the work is keeping the resize handle and keeping a character counter from announcing every keystroke.
demoNote: Type into Short bio with a screen reader on: the count on screen changes with every keystroke, but nothing is spoken until you pause near the limit. Drag the corner of Reply and it stops resizing itself.

contract.useWhen: A multi-line field that keeps its resize handle, with a counter that announces on a pause.
keyboard: native: moves out of the field. It does not insert a tab
native: inserts a line break. It does not submit the form
states: invalid — aria-invalid=true on the control, set only while the error shows
failureModes: resize:none, which is a reflow problem (SC 1.4.4)
the counter announced per keystroke instead of throttled into a polite region
a hard maxlength with no warning, which silently drops what someone typed
the counter as the only sign of the limit, with nothing in the field's description
api: AC.createTextarea(root, options) -> { count, refresh, element, destroy }
